items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: one day the Master Sergeant marched us all out

ctx.x: They just went like, you know, like we lived on post, we lived this part of the post and all the white soldiers lived on that side of the post. Right? And we were the black outfit with all white officers and no black officers. And when I saw a black officer it was like wow, there’s a black captain, can you believe this? I mean we was like amazed. Because we never seen a black officer. And one day the Master Sergeant marched us all out, marched us all out, and they did the same thing across the tracks with the…
And how did people feel about it?
